# Recently Added

New resources accepted into [Awesome Codex CLI](README.md), recorded automatically from changes on main.

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-recently-added.py. Newest entries first. -->

- 2026-10-15 — [Threadlines](https://github.com/Threadlines/threadlines) - Open-source desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) that runs Codex CLI through `codex app-server`, with a live browser, terminal, and source control beside each thread, plus session resume after restarts and a phone client. ([GUI & Apps](README.md#gui--apps))
- 2026-10-15 — [Dory](https://github.com/tjqscott/dory) - Codex project-memory workflow using AGENTS.md directives, linked Markdown wiki pages, and a Python linter to preserve decisions and findings between sessions. ([Workflows & Knowledge Guides 🧠](README.md#workflows--knowledge-guides))
- 2026-10-15 — [coven](https://github.com/OpenCoven/coven) - Local-first daemon and CLI that runs Codex CLI, Claude Code, and other harnesses as PTY sessions inside explicit project-root boundaries, with SQLite-persisted history and a terminal session browser. ([Session Managers](README.md#session-managers))
